Kapil Mishra proposes turning Delhi into global tourism hub at WION summit

At the WION Iconic Tourism Summit, Kapil Mishra outlined plans to transform Delhi into an international tourism hub, highlighting measures such as simplifying visa procedures and introducing direct flights to destinations including Argentina and Africa.
